scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @clashking/api-contracts && npm run build --workspace @clashking/api-client && npm run build --workspace @clashking/api-worker
scripts.dev: npm run docs:build && node scripts/local-api-database.mjs run
scripts.contracts:pack: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/packages',{recursive:true})" && npm pack --workspace @clashking/api-contracts --pack-destination dist/packages && npm pack --workspace @clashking/api-client --pack-destination dist/packages
scripts.test:archive-runtime: npm run docs:build && vitest run --config vitest.archive-runtime.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @clashking/api-contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @clashking/api-client && npm run typecheck --workspace @clashking/api-worker
